latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Maker for LinkedIn.

- Instantly turn a 60-second screen recording or three headshot photos into a LinkedIn-optimized 1080p MP4 video by describing your needs.
- Simple workflow: upload files or images, enter instructions, and download the finished video in under a minute.
- Fully cloud-rendered with no complex timeline editing or export settings required.
- Automatic session and token management for anonymous and registered users.
- Supports quick access to upload, export, credits, and status operations via smart intent detection.
- Compatible with common video formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm) and includes robust error handling.
